hints.title: Boundary Violation Tracking
hints.text: Any element strictly less than minK or strictly greater than maxK invalidates all subarrays spanning across it.

hints.title: Latest Key Indices
hints.text: Maintain the most recent index of an out-of-bounds element last_bad, the latest occurrence of minK last_min, and the latest occurrence of maxK last_max.

hints.title: Valid Left Endpoints
hints.text: For a subarray ending at index i, any starting index j strictly after last_bad and on or before min(last_min, last_max) forms a valid fixed-bound subarray.

hints.title: Three-Pointer Occurrence Tracking Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass updating three index pointers in O(1) per step.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking min and max for all O(n^2) subarrays takes quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) memory tracking three scalar index markers.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Uses three-pointer tracking for bad boundary and key extremes in linear time.
